name: Leaders
overview: Scripture teaches that true leadership in the church is marked by humble service rather than worldly authority, as Jesus instructs that the greatest among believers must be servants (Matthew 20:26; Luke 22:26). Leaders are entrusted by the Holy Spirit to diligently care for God's flock, recognizing the church as purchased by Christ's own blood (Acts 20:28). The heart of leadership involves guarding one's inner life with wisdom (Proverbs 4:23) and treating others with the same respect and kindness one desires (Matthew 7:12), emphasizing servant-heartedness over dominion (Mark 10:42).
